verdict.rationale: A government filing service could plausibly offer a test or sandbox environment for programmatic filers, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no sandbox, test API, or non-production mode. The probes found no API surface at all (OpenAPI paths return 404), and the only online entry point is a production portal behind a CAPTCHA. The fee and franchise-tax calculators are estimation tools, not a sandbox, so they earn no credit.
